dualRoleDesc: . Also serves as advisor. One character can hold a main role plus an optional advisor side job (vanilla Marshall is field_marshal + army_chief). Edit the primary role fields above; advisor settings (slot, cost, traits) are in the ADVISOR SETTINGS section below.
nationalitiesHint: Determines which countries can recruit this operative. Empty = any country.
operativeTraitsHint: vanilla `common/operative_traits/00_operative_traits.txt` lists all available trait ids.
operativeTraitsCatalogHint: Choose operative-compatible traits in the searchable Traits catalog below. Existing imported values stay selected and are never silently overwritten.
guideTitle: Military dual-role guide (primary {role}, secondary advisor / theorist / chief)
guideIntro: In HOI4 the same character can hold a military position and an advisor / theorist / chief slot at the same time. For example, vanilla George Marshall is USA field_marshal and also a high_command (army_chief).
guideStep1: Primary role: {role} is already picked in Role Type above. It sets the military portrait, skill values, and battlefield behavior.
guideStep2: Secondary role: check "Has advisor role" below to open the Advisor Settings panel.
guideStep3: Advisor Slot: pick a slot (army_chief / navy_chief / air_chief / theorist / high_command, etc.)
guideStep4: Advisor Idea Token: fill it in the Advanced Advisor Settings section (auto-generated by default, or override it manually).
guideOutro: Launch HOI4 → pick the country → see the character appear in both menus: unit_leader in the main menu and advisor in the cabinet.
removalCostTooltipTitle: removal_cost · the PP cost to dismiss the advisor
removalCostTooltipContent: Default 150 PP; leave blank to use the default. 0 means free dismissal; 50~150 is the normal political/military advisor range, and a high cost makes the player think twice before dismissing. **Do not write -1**: the export only emits removal_cost for values of 0 or more, so -1 never reaches the mod, and the old 'removal_cost = -1 means cannot be removed' convention no longer works since game 1.12.8. To make an advisor unfireable the base game uses can_be_fired = no; this workbench has no field for it yet, so add it by hand after export.
advisorAvailableTooltip: Advisor availability (hireable) condition. A trigger block — when satisfied the advisor shows up in the hireable list; otherwise it is greyed out / hidden. Difference from visible: visible controls 'whether it appears in the list', available controls 'whether it can be clicked to hire once it appears'. Common usage: available = { has_idea = military_youth } (only hireable with a specific national spirit). Always available by default when unset.
advisorVisibleTooltip: Advisor visibility condition. A trigger block — when not satisfied the advisor does not appear in the advisor pool at all (not even in the list). Stricter than available — when visible fails the user has no idea the advisor exists, ideal for 'hidden advisors unlocked by a focus/event'. Commonly NOT = { has_country_flag = X } for 'invisible until a focus is completed'. Always visible by default when unset.
advisorModifierTooltip: A global modifier block applied to your country while the advisor is active (occupying the advisor slot). Not an effect — it is a continuous modifier (bonus applies throughout the term, removed when they leave). Common content: political_power_gain = 0.05, stability_factor = 0.1, production_factory_max_efficiency_factor = 0.05. Combine with on_add / on_remove for a 'one-time effect on appointment + continuous modifier during the term' combo.
advisorOnAddTooltip: A one-time effect block that runs the moment the advisor is hired. It runs in **character scope**, so a country effect must be wrapped in owner = { ... }; written bare (add_stability = 0.02 on its own) the game rejects it on load and nothing happens when the advisor is hired. Common uses: owner = { set_country_flag = my_advisor_serving } (mark the advisor as serving for later event chains), owner = { add_stability = 0.02 } (appointment honeymoon), owner = { country_event = { id = X days = 7 } } (an intro event 7 days after appointment). Difference from modifier: on_add runs once at appointment, modifier stays in effect for the whole term.
advisorOnRemoveTooltip: A one-time effect block executed the moment the advisor is dismissed/replaced (leaves the advisor slot). Common uses: clr_country_flag (clear the flag set by on_add), add_stability -0.03 (penalty for frequent reshuffling), country_event (fire a resignation-fallout event). Symmetric with on_add — on_add handles 'on appointment', on_remove handles 'on departure'. Triggered by deactivate_advisor or the advisor's death.
traitSearchPlaceholder: Search 1846 vanilla traits by name, or scroll to see custom ones
traitSearchPlaceholderRole: Search vanilla and custom traits for {role}
roleTraitCatalogHint: Only traits compatible with {role} are offered. Type part of a trait id to search.
noMatchHint: No match. To use this trait_id, create it in the "Manage Custom Traits" workbench first — otherwise it gets dropped on export, which is what keeps HOI4 from throwing an invalid-trait error.
invalidTraitTitle: Not in the vanilla trait list, and not in your project's custom traits either. It gets dropped on export. Click to remove.
invalidTraitsWarn: {count} traits are in neither the vanilla trait list nor your custom traits, so they get dropped on export — that's what prevents HOI4's "Invalid country leader trait" error. Define them in "Manage Custom Traits", or click the ⚠ tag to remove them.
invalidRoleTraitsWarn: {count} selected traits are not in the compatible catalog for {role}. They are kept in your draft and marked here so you can define or remove them deliberately.
descriptionPlaceholder: Shown as the character tooltip in-game.
tagTaken: Another character in this project already uses TAG {tag}. Pick a different one.
genderHint: ⚠ HOI4 defaults to male. Verify portrait matches, set "Female" if needed.
canBeCapturedOn: Default. This character can be captured as a general by enemy countries.
canBeCapturedOff: Uncaptured. Immune to capture — emits 'can_be_captured = no'. (Country-leader-role characters are always uncapturable regardless.)
alwaysShowOnActionsOn: Emits 'always_show_on_actions_tooltip = yes' — this advisor is always listed in on_actions tooltips.
alwaysShowOnActionsOff: Unset (engine default) — the key is not written; the game decides when to show this advisor in on_actions tooltips.
alwaysShowOnActionsImported: Imported from this character's advisor block — the original always_show_on_actions_tooltip line is still exported as-is. Tick or untick and save to take over the key here.
replaceVanillaOn: Will override the vanilla character with the same ID. No recruit_character generated.
replaceVanillaOff: New character. Will auto-add recruit_character on startup.
overlayVanillaOn: Skips common/characters/ emit (would collide with vanilla). Trait + portrait edits route through the day-1 trait_overlay event.
overlayVanillaOff: Treats as mod-original leader. Emits to common/characters/<TAG>_<TAG>.txt with full country_leader block. Use this for entirely new characters like USA_donald_trump_modern.
emitTraitOverlayOn: The trait_overlay event and its on_actions hook are generated for you on export. Uncheck this if you'd rather hand-author the overlay event yourself.
emitTraitOverlayOff: No overlay event is generated for this character. You'll need to write events/<X>.txt yourself, with add_*_trait / set_portraits / retire+create blocks.
militaryVisibleHint: Raw HOI4 trigger — controls whether the player can see/recruit this leader. Leave empty for always-visible.
scientistVisibleHint: Raw HOI4 trigger — controls whether this scientist is visible/recruitable. Leave empty for always-visible.
hasAdvisorRoleHint: Some HOI4 characters hold both a primary role (e.g. field_marshal) and an advisor side job. Check this to expose the ADVISOR SETTINGS section below.
noVanillaTraitsHint: No vanilla traits for this role. Use "Manage Custom Traits" to create one.
restoreVanillaIntro: Deletes this replacement character so the vanilla
restoreVanillaIntroSuffix: displays again on next export. Removes:
restoreVanillaItem1: this character row + attached traits / portrait flag
restoreVanillaItem2: next export omits this character from the trait_overlay event
restoreVanillaItem3: history file retire+create block (no longer emitted)
restoreVanillaWarn: Destructive and can't be undone. If you want to keep your custom traits, save them to other characters first.
localisationKeyInvalid: Use only ASCII letters, numbers, underscores, dots, apostrophes, and hyphens.
localisationKeyExplicitHint: Exact key written after name = and into YML. It may differ from the Character TAG.
localisationKeyGeneratedHint: No explicit key set. Preview and export currently use: {key}
localisationStatusLegacy: Legacy value shown; edit to save it in the language map
localisationStatusMissing: Not authored in this language. The field stays empty; export may use the English fallback.
